name: ac-manager-and-vehicle-diligence
description: Evaluating an investment manager and the vehicle that carries the money: the due diligence questionnaire and what it omits, operational due diligence on people and process, the full fee stack and management fee offsets, side letters and most-favoured-nation terms, key-person and succession provisions, governance and alignment, liquidity and gate terms, and the written manager record. It evaluates an allocator's counterparty; it never recommends a manager or predicts returns. Use when asking "manager due diligence", "ODD questionnaire", "side letter", "management fee offset", "key person clause", "most favoured nation", "GP alignment", "should I invest with this manager", "lockup and gates". Not for comparing fund vehicles and tracking (ac-fund-selection), not for fund-level borrowing and continuation vehicles (ac-portfolio-financing), not for the allocation decision (ac-alternatives-and-real-assets).
